# Divulga+ workspace instructions

- Build a responsive, accessible landing page in plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
- Preserve the supplied Divulga+ visual identity, typography, spacing, colors, and section hierarchy.
- Use semantic markup and CSS without requiring a build step.
- Keep content and interactions in Portuguese (Brazil).
- Avoid external image dependencies; use CSS illustration shapes.
- Validate responsive behavior and ensure no horizontal overflow.
